name: Validate b-value Coverage
description: MY-RADS requires at least 2 b-values: low (50-100 s/mm²) and high (800-900/1000 s/mm²). Comprehensive protocol adds intermediate (500-600 s/mm²). (From the MY-RADS Myeloma Whole-Body MRI Guidelines schema.)
implementation:
b_values = value["DiffusionBValue"].dropna().unique()
b_values = sorted([float(b) for b in b_values])

low_b = any(50 <= b <= 100 for b in b_values)
high_b = any(800 <= b <= 1000 for b in b_values)
intermediate_b = any(500 <= b <= 600 for b in b_values)

if not low_b:
    raise ValidationError(f"Missing low b-value (50-100 s/mm²). Found: {b_values}")
if not high_b:
    raise ValidationError(f"Missing high b-value (800-1000 s/mm²). Found: {b_values}")
if len(b_values) < 3 or not intermediate_b:
    raise ValidationWarning(f"Comprehensive protocol recommends 3 b-values including intermediate (500-600). Found: {b_values}")
